key_catalyst: TSMC’s record earnings and higher $60-$64 billion capex outlook triggered a sector-wide semiconductor selloff.
reasoning: TSMC’s record results failing to support its stock, alongside the severe memory-chip collapse, marks an escalation from the earlier AI-capex optimism and raises unresolved valuation risk for QQQ. The 4.60% 10-year yield and persistent Hormuz tensions reinforce the pressure, while Apple’s strength was insufficient to prevent broad technology weakness.
